Position Overview
 DB Global Technology is Deutsche Bank’s technology centre in Central and Eastern Europe. Since its set-up in 2013, Bucharest Technology Centre (BEX) has constantly proven its capacity to deliver global technology products and services, playing a dynamic role in the Bank’s technology transformation.
We have a robust, hands-on engineering culture dedicated to continuous learning, knowledge-sharing, technical skill development and networking. We are an essential part of the Bank’s technology platform and develop applications for many important business areas.
The End User Computing organisation delivers secure connectivity and access services for Deutsche Bank employees. The Zero Trust Senior Engineer will engineer, improve and support secure internet and private application access services in a large, regulated enterprise environment.
The role requires a strong understanding of Zero Trust concepts and practical experience contributing to technology projects from design through implementation and operational handover. Experience with enterprise secure access platforms is important. Zscaler Internet Access and Zscaler Private Access skills are a strong benefit, while experience with REST APIs for automation is a separate nice-to-have capability.
 Responsibilities
Engineer, configure and improve Zero Trust solutions for secure internet and private application access.
Translate security, network and business requirements into reliable technical designs and implementation plans.
Apply Zero Trust principles to user, device, internet and private application access.
Contribute to engineering projects, including requirements analysis, design, testing, implementation, documentation and handover to Operations.
Troubleshoot complex connectivity, policy, authentication and application-access issues, and coordinate vendor escalation where required.
Work with network, security, identity, cloud, endpoint and application teams to deliver integrated solutions.
Create and maintain technical designs, implementation procedures, test cases, release notes and operational documentation.
Identify opportunities to improve service reliability, user experience, monitoring and operational efficiency.
Ensure solutions follow the company’s engineering, security, software development lifecycle and release-management requirements.
 Skills
Strong understanding of Zero Trust principles and their practical application to internet and private application access.
Hands-on engineering experience with enterprise secure access, secure web gateway, zero trust network access or similar security platforms.
Experience designing, implementing or operating secure access solutions in a large enterprise environment.
Experience working in technology projects and contributing across design, build, testing, implementation and handover activities.
Strong understanding of enterprise networking concepts, including IP, routing, DNS, TLS, proxies, firewalls and network troubleshooting.
Experience with identity and access technologies such as SAML-based authentication, multi-factor authentication, certificates and Conditional Access.
Ability to analyse complex technical problems, identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions.
Ability to produce clear technical documentation and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Hands-on engineering experience with Zscaler Private Access.
Experience configuring, troubleshooting and improving enterprise policies across Zscaler services.
Experience using REST APIs to automate configuration, policy management, reporting or operational processes.
Experience with scripting or automation languages such as Python.
Knowledge of tools such as Jira, Confluence, Splunk, Wireshark, Fiddler and ServiceNow.
 Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.
